H0476K.short: Elishama was a Levite sent by King Jehoshaphat to teach the Law in the cities of Judah.

H0476I.name: Elishama

H0476I.short: Elishama was the grandfather of Ishmael, who assassinated Gedaliah, the governor appointed by the Babylonians.

H0476H.name: Elishama

H0472.name: Elisheba

H0469H.name: Elizaphan

H0468.name: Elizur

H0493.name: Elnaam

H0494G.name: Elnathan
H0494G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0494G.brief: Father of Nehushta, King Jehoiachin's mother.

H0494H.name: Elnathan

H0407.name: Achshaph

H0438G.name: Allon

H0425L.name: Elah Valley

H0435.name: Elul
H0435.brief: The sixth month in the ancient Hebrew calendar
H0435.short: Elul, mentioned in <ref="Nehemiah 6:15">Nehemiah 6:15</ref>, is the sixth month in the ancient Hebrew calendar, corresponding to August-September in the modern calendar.
